verification.source_review: Author reviewed the complete sites drawer diff, including browser-only IPC sender/frame checks, validated HTTP(S) navigation without embedded credentials, atomic persistence, legacy defaults, native-view bounds and React text rendering. No SQL, command execution, HTML injection sinks or new secrets introduced.
verification.publication_inventory: Source, tests, documentation and package version only. Personal profiles, cookies, credentials, dependencies and build outputs excluded from Git.
verification.instructions_review: Release and setup prose checked for prompt injection or exfiltration instructions; none found.

limitations: Manual review and tests do not prove absence of vulnerabilities.
Third-party site authentication and media playback were not verified; navigation is tested against a local HTTP fixture.
